abilities.name: Firebreak Vow
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Grit against red threats and enemies in ember or fire sectors.

abilities.name: Smoke Sniffer
abilities.text: Once per round, before you resolve a red hazard or fire-marked sector action, inspect the target or blocker summary before choosing Gear.

abilities.name: Cinder Hug
abilities.text: Once per round, when another operative in your sector would take 1 Wound or retreat from a red threat, you may take 1 Wound to cancel that effect for them.

abilities.name: Foam and Fury
abilities.text: After you defeat a red threat, reduce scenario pressure by 1 if it is above 0. Weakness: you suffer -1 on blue Anomaly tests.
